material_status: Historical names used only as symbolic designations. No physical prize is offered by default.

references.name: R. Daniel Mauldin (ed.), The Scottish Book, 2nd ed. (Springer, 2015)
University of St Andrews, MacTutor, Stanisław Mazur

rewards.label: A small black coffee
rewards.historical_note: A small black coffee appears among the rewards specified by Hugo Steinhaus for Problem 152.

rewards.label: One small beer
rewards.historical_note: Small beer was a recorded Scottish Book prize, including one outcome of Problem 152.

rewards.label: Five small beers
rewards.historical_note: Five small beers appear among the historical Scottish Book prizes.

rewards.label: A bottle of wine
rewards.historical_note: A bottle of wine was offered for several Scottish Book problems, including Problem 6.

rewards.label: A bottle of whisky of positive measure
rewards.historical_note: The whisky prize is mentioned in the preface of Mauldin's edition.

rewards.label: One hundred grams of caviar
rewards.historical_note: Hugo Steinhaus's Problem 152 offered caviar for an explicit numerical determination.

rewards.label: One kilogram of bacon
rewards.historical_note: One kilogram of bacon is among the prizes in the Scottish Book.

rewards.label: A live goose
rewards.historical_note: Stanisław Mazur offered a live goose for Problem 153, awarded to Per Enflo in 1972.
